title: Small-Sensor Display Agreement — Protocol Closeout
summary: Administrative closeout record for the completed Small-Sensor Display Agreement protocol and its approved public method summary.

sections.title: ADMINISTRATIVE RECORD
sections.body:
**Study reference:** ST-24-018

**Protocol revision:** 1.1

**Responsible unit:** Participant Programs Office

**Administrative state:** Protocol complete

**Effective date:** 2024-11-21

**Personnel record:** Role-only archive copy

sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:
**Objective:** Confirm completion of the approved tabletop display-comparison protocol, reconcile the required observation materials, and prepare a bounded public result summary.

**Scope limitation:** This record contains protocol administration only. It contains no participant identities, contact details, device identifiers, exact locations, or individual response data.

sections.title: METHOD & OBSERVATIONS
sections.body:
**Administrative review:** The protocol sequence, fixed response categories, stated exclusions, and public limitations were compared with the final approved study materials.

**Observation:** Required closeout elements were present and the public summary remained limited to method-level findings. No product ranking, accuracy certification, or individual device result was released.

sections.title: DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Disposition:** Archive the protocol administration record and retain the approved public summary with the study register.

**Follow-up:** Any future display-comparison series requires a new protocol revision and separate participation review.

**Review status:** Administrative closeout complete.
